params.name: background.blur.mode
params.description:
Type of blur to apply to the background.
- `gaussian`: Applies a gaussian blur to the background.
- `bokeh`: Applies a bokeh blur to the background.

params.name: background.blur.radius
params.description:
Radius of the blur effect. Higher values mean the result will be blurrier.

Minimum: 0, Maximum: 0.05

params.name: background.color
params.description:
Color of the background. If omitted, background will be transparent unless `background.imageUrl` or `background.imageFile` is provided. Can be a hex color without the hash sign (example: `FF0000`, `FF0000EE`) or color name (examples: `red`, `blue`)

When `removeBackground` is set to `false`, the color will be used to fill padding areas created by `outputSize` and any transparent areas in the original image.

params.name: background.expandPrompt
params.description:
If `ai.auto`, a pre-processing step is applied to expand the prompt into a longer form.

`auto` and `never` are legacy values that will be removed in the next major version.

params.name: background.guidance.imageFile
params.description:
Bytes of the image to use as a background image guidance. Only available in the POST request

Can't be provided if `removeBackground` is set to `false`

The maximum size of the image is 30MB.

params.name: background.guidance.imageUrl
params.description:
URL of the image to use as a background image guidance.

Can't be provided if `removeBackground` is set to `false`

The maximum size of the image is 30MB.

params.name: background.guidance.scale
params.description:
How closely the generated background will be matching the guiding image, between 0 and 1.

A value of 1 means it will match the guiding image as much as possible, a value of 0 means the guiding image will be ignored.

(Only working when using the [new model](https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/ai-backgrounds#important-model-selection))

params.name: background.imageUrl
params.description:
URL of the image to use as a background.

Can't be provided if `removeBackground` is set to `false`

The maximum size of the image is 30MB.

If `background.imageUrl` is provided, neither `background.imageFile` nor `background.prompt` can be provided, and vice versa.

params.name: background.negativePrompt
params.description:
(LEGACY) This parameter will only have an effect when using the previous AI Backgrounds model, which is used when setting the header: `pr-ai-background-model-version: 2`

A negative prompt to use for guiding the background generation process; If provided, the generation algorithm will try to avoid properties listed in the negativePrompt.

params.name: background.prompt
params.description:
Prompt to use for guiding the background generation process.

Tips for writing high-quality prompts are available [in our documentation](https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/ai-backgrounds#how-to-write-a-high-quality-prompt).

If `background.prompt` is provided, neither `background.imageUrl` nor `background.imageFile` can be provided, and vice versa.

params.name: background.scaling
params.description:
Whether the background should fit or fill (default) the output image If set to `fit`, the empty pixels will be transparent

Can only be provided if `background.imageUrl` or `background.imageFile` is provided

params.name: background.seed
params.description: Seed used to generate the background. Can be used to get similar looking results for the same prompt.

params.name: beautify.mode
params.description:
If enabled, the input image will be beautified (imageFile or imageUrl).

This is intended to enhance product images by automatically improving the aesthetics of the image, such as the lighting, background, and overall appearance.

If set to `ai.auto`, the input image will be beautified to match the aesthetic of a packshot product image.

If set to `ai.food`, the input image will be beautified in a way that's specific to food images, such as placing the subject on a plate.

If set to `ai.car`, the input image will be beautified in a way that's specific to car images, such as removing reflections.

Important:
- the beautifier will not preserve the original background: we recommend using this option along with `removeBackground` set to `true`
- the beautifier is meant for images of products, food, or cars; we do not recommend using it with subjects such as humans, pets, etc.

params.name: beautify.seed
params.description: Seed used to run the subject beautifier. Can be used to get similar looking results for the same subject.

params.name: describeAnyChange.mode
params.description:
(DEPRECATED) Use `editWithAI.mode` instead.

Describe any change mode to use on the main image used by the API.

Currently, only `ai.auto` is supported.

params.name: describeAnyChange.prompt
params.description:
(DEPRECATED) Use `editWithAI.prompt` instead.

The natural language prompt describing the change to apply to the image.

params.name: describeAnyChange.seed
params.description:
(DEPRECATED) Use `editWithAI.seed` instead.

Seed used for the generation. Can be used to get similar looking results for the same prompt.

params.name: editWithAI.additionalImages.{key}.imageUrl
params.description: URL of an additional reference image.

params.name: editWithAI.mode
params.description:
Edit with AI mode to use on the main image used by the API.

Currently, only `ai.auto` is supported.

params.name: editWithAI.prompt
params.description: The natural language prompt describing the change to apply to the image.

params.name: editWithAI.seed
params.description: Seed used for the generation. Can be used to get similar looking results for the same prompt.

params.name: expand.mode
params.description:
Expand mode to use on the main image used by the API.

If set to `ai.auto`, all transparent pixels will automatically be filled based on the content of the current background (either the original background, if `removeBackground` has been set to `false`, or a static background, if `background.imageUrl` has been provided)

Expand will rely on output size, subject position, and fitting mode.

params.name: expand.seed
params.description: Seed used to generate the background. Can be used to get similar looking results for the same prompt.

params.name: export.dpi
params.description:
The pixel density of the result image.

Pixel density can be set to any value between 72 and 1200 dpi.

params.name: export.format
params.description:
The format of the result image.

Default value is "png".

Jpeg exports with a quality of 80 and WebP exports with a quality of 90.

params.name: flatLay.mode
params.description: Must be set to `ai.auto` to enable flat lay generation.

params.name: flatLay.prompt
params.description: Optional text prompt to guide the generation style.

params.name: flatLay.size
params.description: The output size of the generated image.

params.name: ghostMannequin.mode
params.description: Must be set to `ai.auto` to enable ghost mannequin generation.

params.name: ghostMannequin.prompt
params.description: Optional text prompt to guide the generation style.

params.name: ghostMannequin.size
params.description: The output size of the generated image.

params.name: horizontalAlignment
params.description:
[Advanced] Defines the horizontal alignment of the cutout subject within its bounding box.

Specifying a custom horizontal alignment will implicitly set `ignorePaddingAndSnapOnCroppedSides` to `false` for the horizontal direction.

params.name: ignorePaddingAndSnapOnCroppedSides
params.description:
If set to `true` (default), cropped sides of the subject will snap to the edges For instance, for a portrait image cropped below the elbows, the subject will be aligned at the bottom even if a bottom padding is provided (but it will still respect bottom margin)

Can't be provided if `removeBackground` is set to `false`

(See positioning section of the documentation for more information)

params.name: imageFromPrompt.prompt
params.description: The prompt to use for generating the image.

params.name: imageFromPrompt.seed
params.description: Seed used to run the AI image generator. Can be used to get similar looking results for the same prompt.

params.name: imageFromPrompt.size
params.description: Supported sizes for AI image generation

params.name: imageUrl
params.description:
URL of the main image used by the API. The GET endpoint accepts `imageUrl` only.

The maximum size of the image is 30MB.

If you want to directly upload an image file, please instead use the POST endpoint with the argument `imageFile`.

params.name: keepExistingAlphaChannel
params.description: If set to `auto` and if the image has transparency, the existing transparency will be used to cutout the subject.

params.name: lighting.mode
params.description:
Lighting mode to use on the main image used by the API.

If set to `ai.auto`, the lighting will be automatically adjusted

If set to `ai.preserve-hue-and-saturation`, the lighting will be adjusted while keeping color hues and saturations as close as possible to the original image

params.name: margin
params.description:
General margin around the subject. Can be expressed as a number between 0 and 0.49, a percentage string between 0% and 49% (e.g., "30%"), or a pixel value string (e.g., "100px"). Unlike `padding`, margin is never ignored even on cropped sides of the subject. Expressed in a ratio of the output image size. See positioning section of the documentation for more information.

Tips to assist with positioning are available [in our documentation](https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/positioning).

params.name: marginBottom
params.description: Bottom Margin, overrides general margin on the bottom side. Accepts the same formats as `margin`.

params.name: marginLeft
params.description: Left Margin, overrides general margin on the left side. Accepts the same formats as `margin`.

params.name: marginRight
params.description: Right Margin, overrides general margin on the right side. Accepts the same formats as `margin`.

params.name: marginTop
params.description: Top Margin, overrides general margin on the top side. Accepts the same formats as `margin`.

params.name: maxHeight
params.description: Maximum output height. Can only be provided if `outputSize` is `originalImage` or `croppedSubject`. Useful for: redimensioning while keeping the aspect ratio

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: Maximum output width. Can only be provided if `outputSize` is `originalImage` or `croppedSubject`. Useful for: resizing an image while keeping the aspect ratio

params.name: outline.blurRadius
params.description:
Blur radius for the outline, creating a glow or soft edge effect. Higher values mean the outline will be more blurred, 0 means no blur.

Minimum: 0, Maximum: 0.025

params.name: outline.color
params.description: Apply a colored outline around the subject to highlight it. Can be a hex color without the hash sign (example: `FF0000`, `FF0000EE`) or color name (examples: `red`, `blue`)

params.name: outline.width
params.description:
Width of the outline relative to the image size. Suggested values:
- 0.01-0.02: Subtle/thin outline
- 0.03-0.05: Standard/medium outline (default: 0.03)
- 0.06-0.1: Bold/thick outline The value represents a ratio where 0.1 (10%) is the maximum thickness.

Minimum: 0, Maximum: 0.1

params.name: outputSize
params.description:
Output size of the image. In the form of either:
- `auto` to keep the template dimensions when templateId is defined, or behave like `originalImage` when templateId isn't defined (default)
- `widthxheight` for a custom size (example: `200x400`)
- `originalImage` to keep the original image dimensions
- `croppedSubject` to use the size of the foreground dimensions after cropping around it

params.name: padding
params.description:
General padding around the subject. Can be expressed as a number between 0 and 0.49, a percentage string between 0% and 49% (e.g., "30%"), or a pixel value string (e.g., "100px"). Unlike `margin`, padding will be ignored on cropped sides of the subject if that option is enabled. Expressed in a ratio of the size of the document, minus margins (similar to CSS). See positioning section of the documentation for more information.

Tips to assist with positioning are available [in our documentation](https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/positioning).

params.name: paddingBottom
params.description: Bottom padding, overrides general padding on the bottom side. Accepts the same formats as `padding`.

params.name: paddingLeft
params.description: Left padding, overrides general padding on the left side. Accepts the same formats as `padding`.

params.name: paddingRight
params.description: Right padding, overrides general padding on the right side. Accepts the same formats as `padding`.

params.name: paddingTop
params.description: Top padding, overrides general padding on the top side. Accepts the same formats as `padding`.

params.name: preserveMetadata
params.description:
Controls which metadata from the original image will be preserved in the output image.

- `never`: No metadata preservation (default)
- `xmp`: Preserve XMP metadata including camera settings, copyright information, and other embedded metadata
- `exifSubset`: Preserve EXIF Copyright (IFD0) and UserComment (ExifIFD) fields only.   **Deprecated** — use `exifSubsetWithXmpCompatibility` instead. Will be removed in a future release.
- `exifSubsetWithXmpCompatibility`: Same as `exifSubset` but also writes Copyright and   UserComment as XMP fields (dc:rights / exif:UserComment) for applications that read   XMP instead of EXIF (e.g. Adobe products, macOS Preview).

params.name: referenceBox
params.description:
[Advanced] `subjectBox` by default. When set to `originalImage`, the padding / margin will be around the original image and not the cropped subject.

It can lead to the subject disappearing when scaling is set to 'fill', for instance if the subject is on the left of a landscape image and outputSize is a square.

Most use cases don't require this option. It is useful if you'd like to maintain subject positioning in the original image.

Can't be provided if `removeBackground` is set to `false`

(See positioning section of the documentation for more information)

params.name: removeBackground
params.description: If enabled (default), the background of the image will be removed using PhotoRoom's award-winning algorithm

params.name: scaling
params.description:
Whether the subject should fit (default) or fill the output image If set to `fit`, the empty pixels will be transparent

Can only be provided if `imageUrl` or `imageFile` is provided

params.name: segmentation.mode
params.description: Controls whether or not the salient object should be kept or ignored by the segmentation model.

params.name: segmentation.negativePrompt
params.description: A textual description of what the segmentation should remove.

params.name: segmentation.prompt
params.description: Warning: Text-Guided Segmentation is available as a preview feature. As such, please be aware that there could be breaking changes with a 2-week notice period. A textual description of what the segmentation should keep.

params.name: shadow.directionOverride
params.description:
Override for the direction of the shadow.

Can be provided either as an angle in degrees or as one of the following presets:
- `behind` = 0
- `behindLeft` = 45
- `left` = 90
- `frontLeft` = 135
- `front` = 180
- `frontRight` = 225
- `right` = 270
- `behindRight` = 315

When using degrees, 0 means the shadow is behind the subject, 90 means the shadow is at the left of the subject, 180 means the shadow is in front of the subject, and 270 means the shadow is at the right of the subject.

This option is only supported by the `2026-04-15` AI Shadows model. It requires setting `shadow.mode` to `ai.auto-with-overrides`.

params.name: shadow.intensityOverride
params.description:
Override for the intensity of the shadow.

0 means a very faint shadow, 1 means a very dark shadow.

This option is only supported by the `2026-04-15` AI Shadows model. It requires setting `shadow.mode` to `ai.auto-with-overrides`.

params.name: shadow.mode
params.description: Shadow generation mode to use on the main image used by the API. If set to `ai.soft`, a soft shadow will be generated. Only compatible with legacy AI Shadows models If set to `ai.hard`, a hard shadow will be generated. Only compatible with legacy AI Shadows models If set to `ai.floating`, a floating shadow will be generated. Not compatible with the `2026-04-15` AI Shadows model If set to `ai.preset-soft`, a soft shadow will be generated. Only compatible with the `2026-04-15` AI Shadows model If set to `ai.preset-hard`, a hard shadow will be generated. Only compatible with the `2026-04-15` AI Shadows model If set to `ai.auto-with-overrides`, a shadow with most natural appearance for the input image will be generated. Override parameters can be provided to gain full control over the appearance of that shadow. Only compatible with the `2026-04-15` AI Shadows model

params.name: shadow.softnessOverride
params.description:
Override for the softness of the shadow.

0 means a very hard shadow, 1 means a very soft shadow.

This option is only supported by the `2026-04-15` AI Shadows model. It requires setting `shadow.mode` to `ai.auto-with-overrides`.

params.name: shadow.spreadOverride
params.description:
Override for the spread of the shadow.

Can be provided either as an angle in degrees or as one of the following presets:
- `short` = 10
- `medium` = 45
- `long` = 90

When using degrees, 0 means a very short shadow and 90 means a very long shadow.

This option is only supported by the `2026-04-15` AI Shadows model. It requires setting `shadow.mode` to `ai.auto-with-overrides`.

params.name: shadow.subjectPoseOverride
params.description:
Override for the pose of the subject.

Can be provided either as an angle in degrees or as one of the following presets:
- `flatlay` = 0
- `upright` = 90

When using degrees, 0 means the subject is laying flat and 90 means the subject is placed upright.

This option is only supported by the `2026-04-15` AI Shadows model. It requires setting `shadow.mode` to `ai.auto-with-overrides`.

params.name: templateId
params.description: The ID of the template to render

params.name: textRemoval.mode
params.description:
Text removal mode to use on the main image used by the API.

If set to `ai.artificial`, artificial text will be automatically removed. Artificial text includes all text added on an image through post-precessing, such as company name, watermarks, discount, etc.

If set to `ai.natural`, natural text will be automatically removed. Natural text includes text that naturally occurs in an image such as writing on buildings or clothings, road signs, etc.

If set to `ai.all`, all text (natural and artificial) will be automatically removed.

params.name: uncrop.mode
params.description:
Uncrop mode to use on the main image used by the API.

Currently, only `ai.auto` is supported. With `ai.auto`, the subject will be automatically detected and uncropped.

params.name: uncrop.seed
params.description: Seed used to generate the background. Can be used to get similar looking results for the same prompt.

params.name: upscale.downscaleIfNeeded
params.description:
Optional input downscaling strategy applied before AI Upscale when the selected model rejects the current input size.

`never`: keep the current behavior and return an error when the image is too large. `always`: downscale oversized images to the largest input size accepted by the selected model before upscaling. `skipUpscaleIfNotNeeded`: only downscale oversized images when the 4x upscaled result can still be at least as large as the original input.

params.name: upscale.mode
params.description:
Warning: AI Upscale is available as a preview feature. As such, please be aware that there could be breaking changes with a 2-week notice period.

If enabled, the input image will be upscaled (imageFile or imageUrl)

Input limits depend on the model selected for AI Upscale. With the default model:
- `ai.fast`: maximum 1,000,000 input pixels
- `ai.slow`: maximum 262,144 input pixels

The upscaling process will enlarge the input image up to 4 times its original size. This will significantly increase the resolution and affect both the input processing and the final output dimensions.

ai.fast: This algorithm is optimized for speed and may not produce the highest quality results. ai.slow: This algorithm is optimized for quality and may take more time to process.

params.name: verticalAlignment
params.description:
[Advanced] Defines the vertical alignment of the cutout subject within its bounding box.

Specifying a custom vertical alignment will implicitly set `ignorePaddingAndSnapOnCroppedSides` to `false` for the vertical direction.

params.name: virtualModel.additionalProductImages
params.description: Additional product images showing different angles or details of the same item. These help the model better understand the product and generate more accurate results.

params.name: virtualModel.mode
params.description: Must be set to `ai.auto` to enable virtual model generation.

params.name: virtualModel.model
params.description: The model (person) to use for the virtual try-on. Either a preset model name or a custom image.

params.name: virtualModel.pose
params.description: The pose of the model in the generated image.

params.name: virtualModel.prompt
params.description: Optional text prompt to guide the generation style.

params.name: virtualModel.quality
params.description: The output quality of the generated image. Higher quality produces larger images. `standard` outputs ~1K, `advanced` ~2K, and `premium` ~4K resolution.

params.name: virtualModel.scene
params.description: The scene (background/environment) to use. Either a preset scene name or a custom image.

params.name: virtualModel.size
params.description: The output size of the generated image.

items.docs: This endpoint processes an image and applies one or more edits: background removal, AI-generated backgrounds (background.prompt), realistic shadows (shadow.mode), relighting (lighting.mode), text removal (textRemoval.mode), background blur (background.blur.*), subject outline (outline.*), AI beautification (beautify.mode), Flat Lay (flatLay.*), Ghost Mannequin (ghostMannequin.*), Virtual Model (virtualModel.*), AI expand (expand.mode), AI uncrop (uncrop.mode), AI upscale (upscale.mode), and posi

This endpoint processes an image and applies one or more edits: background removal, AI-generated backgrounds (background.prompt), realistic shadows (shadow.mode), relighting (lighting.mode), text removal (textRemoval.mode), background blur (background.blur.*), subject outline (outline.*), AI beautification (beautify.mode), Flat Lay (flatLay.*), Ghost Mannequin (ghostMannequin.*), Virtual Model (virtualModel.*), AI expand (expand.mode), AI uncrop (uncrop.mode), AI upscale (upscale.mode), and posi

params.name: apiKey
params.description: The API key to authenticate the request

params.name: templateId
params.description: The ID of the template to render

params.name: imageUrl
params.description: The image URL to render

params.name: conceptUrl
params.description: Deprecated, use `imageUrl` instead.
